about: Batch 2 (the Staff Building Steps, the Mountain Path, the Main Gate) was written early, on 7 Oct 2026, at the owner's word,
The record it was composed from is that copy: tools/bgs/campus.json of 7 Oct with the three yards the owner chose (B, A, B) fixed from a first-guess
layout read off the pictures by eye, the four reference pictures refitted by the installer's own function (no black rows at the top or bottom),
and one sentence about the tower and the pagodas in the facts of each of the three places.
A sum is the sha256 of a prompt's UTF-8 text (the first widget value of its GeminiImage2Node) or of a reference file's bytes.
Whether a picture is accepted is plan 5.2's pass rule at its layout sitting, as for any render.

chosen.said: the owner, in chat, 7 Oct 2026: "The images are done. With the trailhead, we can see the veil in the background. But there not accurate to the. We'll redo it but i can provide references as to what the veils look like." and "B for staff yard, A for main gate, we can redo the main gate to make it more feel more like a main gate"

staff_yard.note: read by eye against its checklist: all yes (the small detached office on the left, the principal's hall ahead at the top of the steps, the office pavilion with the round window on the right, the teachers' house beyond it with its bamboo fence, the paved path back to the garden at the bottom left, the walled steps down to the training yard at the bottom right). No tower and no pagoda. One unnamed timber building shows at the far left edge.

gate.note: TO BE REDONE at the owner's word: it should feel more like a main gate. Version A agrees with the chosen Courtyard (the schoolhouse on the left, the training hall on the right, the gateway beyond, the pagoda behind the schoolhouse), but the torii stands a few steps below the court and reads as a small shrine entrance. The record's words for the gate are a proposal and may be rewritten.

trailhead.note: TO BE REDONE at the owner's word: the veil is not drawn as a veil should look (version A: a flat grey wall on the hilltop; version B: dark streaks in the sky). The owner will give reference pictures. In the story the veil is a dome kept over the ridge's peak day and night (ch2_tour.rpy; the placeholder bg ridge_veil is a dark violet dome over the peak), not something beyond the far mountains as the record's look line for the ridge says: that line is a proposal and is rewritten with the references. Everything else in both versions reads yes down the checklist.
